query.queryString:
declare query_parameters(startTime:datetime, endTime:datetime);
tracked_whale_trades()
| where timestamp between (startTime .. endTime)
| project timestamp, symbol, side, qty, price, notional, ord_type, trade_id

payload.name: Whale trade on a tracked pair
